_about: CANDIDATE holidays only — importing this does NOT make any day a holiday.
This file carries only holidays whose dates are fixed by the Gregorian
calendar or solar-reckoned (the Pongal cluster, Tamil New Year). Lunar
festivals — Diwali, Holi, the two Eids, Dussehra, Ayudha Puja, Onam — are
deliberately OMITTED for 2027 rather than guessed: their dates are published
closer to the year, and a wrong holiday date rewrites attendance for every
Add them on the admin Holiday Calendar page once the Tamil Nadu government
list for 2027 is published, or drop an updated IN-2027.json into this folder.

holidays.name: New Year's Day
holidays.notes: Fixed date. Observed as a corporate holiday by most companies.

holidays.name: Pongal (Thai Pongal)
holidays.notes: Solar calendar — 14 January. Most Chennai employers close 14-16 January.

holidays.name: Makar Sankranti
holidays.notes: Solar calendar — 14 January. The same day as Pongal.

holidays.name: Thiruvalluvar Day
holidays.notes: Tamil Nadu government holiday, day after Pongal.

holidays.name: Uzhavar Thirunal (Farmers' Day)
holidays.notes: Tamil Nadu government holiday, third day of the Pongal cluster.

holidays.name: Tamil New Year (Puthandu)
holidays.notes: Solar calendar — 14 April. Tamil Nadu government holiday.

holidays.name: Dr. Ambedkar Jayanti
holidays.notes: Fixed date. Public holiday in most states, including Tamil Nadu.

holidays.name: May Day / Labour Day
holidays.notes: Fixed date. A state holiday in Tamil Nadu and many others.
